headline: Cranial nerves: sensory, motor or both?
stat_note: Some Say Marry Money But My Brother Says Big Brains Matter More
body:
Sensory: I, II, VIII
Motor: III, IV, VI, XI, XII
Both: V, VII, IX, X

headline: Kids have 20 teeth. Adults have 32.
body: Most children have 20 primary (baby) teeth. Most adults have 8 incisors, 4 canines, 8 premolars and 12 molars.

headline: More than half your bones are in your hands and feet
stat_note: bones in both hands and feet together
body: Each hand has 27 bones and each foot has 26. Together that's 106 of your 206 bones.
source: Source: Cleveland Clinic, 15 Fun Facts About Bones
